description: init.sh builds .venv and runs every test offline. A conftest guard fails any test that opens a non-local connection, and one test proves the guard.
TaskDesk fake API: about 25 endpoints over projects, tasks, comments and users, seeded data, standard library only.
40 scripted tasks with checkable end states and a scorer that reads the fake API database at the end of a run.
Shape A: one tool per endpoint.
Shape B: fewer task-sized tools.
Shape C: search_api to find operations and run_code to run a short script against a typed client.

run_code sandbox: child process with CPU, memory and wall-clock limits, an AST allowlist and an audit hook. Tests show no network except the fake API, no file reads outside the temp dir, and a stop at the time limit.
Capability matrix test: every one of the API operations is reachable through all three shapes with the same effect on the database.
Each shape runs as a real MCP server over stdio with the official MCP Python SDK, and its tool list matches the in-process shape.
The oracle agent solves all 40 tasks in all three shapes, and the wrong agents fail all of them.
Tool definition sizes for each shape, counted from the MCP tool lists before any model runs, written to results/tool_sizes.json and the README.
Minimal tool-calling agent loop for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with record mode and fixture replay. Tool output goes back as data.
Resumable record run: a state machine over (task, shape, repetition) with pending, done and failed states. A test stops a run and resumes it.
At least one record-mode run with one free model covers 40 tasks in all three shapes, and the README states the model, date, repetitions and intervals.
Metrics and report: success with intervals, calls per task, definition tokens, round-trip tokens, latency, paired differences between shapes, per-task breakdown and a when-each-shape-wins guide.
docs/ADDING_A_SHAPE.md explains how to add your own server shape, and a test runs the example shape from the guide.
README has the Part 1 parts in order, generated tables, CI badge and a test that fails when a README number does not match its results file.
CI workflow (passes actionlint), issue templates, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, topics, social preview made by a script, static results page, docs/DEMO.md transcript, scripts/check_links.py.
Study-later kit: docs/WALKTHROUGH.md, docs/INTERVIEW_QA.md with the interview points, DECISIONS.md.
MCP scanner run on each shape's exported tool list, results in docs/SECURITY_CHECKS.md.
Release check (section 11) done and logged in docs/RELEASE_CHECK.md.
Hand-off: CHANGELOG v0.1.0-rc1 with the release SHA, docs/HUMAN_STEPS.md, docs/handoff/COWORK_PROMPT.md, docs/GITHUB_ABOUT.md, docs/topics.txt.
